tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background, and the sidebar, which sits on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, list panes and inputs on the ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Quiet insets: evidence quotes, key-value wells, segmented control tracks.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px edges of cards, panes and tables. A border or a tone step, never a shadow.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Row rules inside lists and tables.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and outlined buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All running text, headings and figures.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and labels. Passes 4.5:1 on ground, surface and raised.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one filled button per screen, including Open in WhatsApp.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Raspberry. Data and small marks only: lit tiles, fit bars, active nav icon, tab underline, claim underline.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Area tint: selected row, active nav row, sourced claim fill.

tokens.name: accent-track
tokens.usage: Stronger tint: tracks of progress bars, partly lit tiles.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Raspberry text on accent-soft and accent-track.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Positive figures and the done mark.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for confirmed, replied, won.

tokens.name: positive-ink
tokens.usage: Pill text for confirmed, replied, won.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for guessed, single source, paused.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Pill text for guessed, single source, paused.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Negative marks: a failed step, a bounced email.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for wrong number, bounced, lost.

tokens.name: negative-ink
tokens.usage: Pill text for wrong number, bounced, lost.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for not yet, sent, no website.

tokens.name: neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Pill text on neutral-soft.

tokens.name: mono-1
tokens.usage: Business monogram tint 1 (raspberry family).

tokens.name: mono-1-ink
tokens.usage: Letters on mono-1.

tokens.name: mono-2
tokens.usage: Business monogram tint 2 (teal).

tokens.name: mono-2-ink
tokens.usage: Letters on mono-2.

tokens.name: mono-3
tokens.usage: Business monogram tint 3 (millet).

tokens.name: mono-3-ink
tokens.usage: Letters on mono-3.

tokens.name: mono-4
tokens.usage: Business monogram tint 4 (sky).

tokens.name: mono-4-ink
tokens.usage: Letters on mono-4.

tokens.name: mono-5
tokens.usage: Business monogram tint 5 (leaf).

tokens.name: mono-5-ink
tokens.usage: Letters on mono-5.

tokens.name: mono-6
tokens.usage: Business monogram tint 6 (clay).

tokens.name: mono-6-ink
tokens.usage: Letters on mono-6.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing headline only, at 1440px. Scales with clamp(56px, 9vw, 150px). Tracking -0.04em.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: Section headlines on pages. Two lines at most.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen title, the h1. The only 700 on a screen.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Labels in sentence case, meta, pills. Nothing smaller.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to word, inside pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips and stacked lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone margins, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The app gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between bands on app screens.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Between sections on pages.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Map tiles and the tile mark.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, monograms.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panes.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only for what floats: popovers, menus, the mobile bottom sheet.
